title: Trust cert-manager CA certificates for Kanidm

required_properties: When ca.crt is present in the configured TLS Secret, Kaniop uses it as the Kanidm client trust anchor
When ca.crt is absent, Kaniop preserves the existing fallback to the final certificate in tls.crt
Native/system CA roots remain disabled for the operator Kanidm client
Regression tests cover both ca.crt and tls.crt trust-anchor layouts
forbidden_changes: Enable native/system CA roots for the Kanidm client
Require users to append the private root CA to tls.crt
Remove the existing tls.crt chain fallback
